## render_source_findings (audits/render_source/insulin_pump_program_services/findings.md)
| Id | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| F1 factor tier reads other factors; points bear weight only on burden tier 2 | **CONFIRMED** (source-side, medium) | `fx_hw_burden.ladder[1]` "standard share percent plus all the points"; each points rule sentence says "the share rises by …" unconditionally while the burden "otherwise" tier is "the standard waiver"; KB mirrors this (`multi_program_balance_burden` row 4 "50 percent of the waiver base" beside five points docs stating an unconditional rise), so on a world where neither or both other programs carry a balance the visible points docs and the burden table disagree in the same way the source does. Not triggered in task 1 (tier 2). |
| F2 reversal zeroes every non-CO-151 charge under review | **CONFIRMED** (source-side, medium) | rule/compute "denied units … none where no such denial is on file"; base `pump_liability_notice` + `pump_evt_denials_and_appeals` let PR-204 / non-appealable CO-197 lines carry a notice-backed non-covered charge; the only overwrite retires the cash-price measure, not that permission. Not triggered (task 0's reviewed line is CO-151). |
| F3 "a notice" vs compute newest notice | **CONFIRMED** (source-side, low) | compute `nt_date`/`nt_units` = `LATEST(... related_pump_order_id=d_grant)`, `liab_basis` tests only that date; KB follows the rule ("a liability notice signed … on or before the line's ship date"). Each grant in task 0 has one notice → no effect. |
| F4 past-due gate on past_due_hold_days = 0 | **CONFIRMED** (source-side, low) | both gate sentences unconditional; `patient_account_terms_by_tier` (from `parameter_schema`) "0 means shipments are never held for a past-due balance"; measure would count every posting older than 0 days on Medicaid. |
| F5 household tier with approved CGM plan but no active CGM program | **CONFIRMED** (source-side, low) | compute `cgm_balance = CFIELD(... status='active') or 0` → short extension; rule wording covers neither case. |
| F6 notice overwrite retires a clause its replacement restates | **CONFIRMED** (low, no effect) | superseded "the customer signs it personally, and no Larkfield representative can sign it for them" is contained in replaced_by; KB marker and replacement consistent. |
| F7 window boundaries stated only for dispensing windows | **CONFIRMED** (source-side, low) | refill rules define the convention for dispensings; order windows rendered with compute's `within_months` convention (traceable); 12-/24-month windows carry no boundary sentence in rule or KB. |
| Base text notes (parameter name in `pump_agg_multi_holding.rule`; policy ids in base prose) | CONFIRMED, cosmetic | rendered correctly as "at most 1" and as business references; no rework needed, not routed. |

Auditor's own source-side notes: **S1** (low-medium) `pump_ext_remittance_posting_correction` — "Returned units come off the line's denied units first …" beside "the denied units times the value of a denied unit come off" leaves open whether the CO-151 deduction uses the denied units before or after returns; compute uses before (`rc_off = rc_denied * rc_unit_value`, 45.00 → 48.00), the other reading gives 6.21 on task 1; KB carries the source wording verbatim. **S2** (low) baselines embed factor-only quantities and zero-default/assembly terms naming factor outputs (root wording behind KB-B1). **S3** (low) plan left-out rule silent on which of several received applications / approved plans is read (compute LATEST).
